title: credential body claude_subscription
description: Plaintext body of the credential kind claude_subscription inside the record ciphertext (04-crypto.md section 4.4). kind setup_token: a long-lived token of `claude setup-token`; kind login_token: the access token of the user's local Claude Code login, transferred by the user's agent tool, with its expiry (11-agent-access.md section 8, ADR-056). Several records per user (ADR-090): name and note are the owner's label and remark, use says which sessions besides the owner's own (the primary record) may use it; a record without token is not logged in (it serves nothing and is not measured).

name.description: the owner's label of the subscription (no control character)

note.description: the owner's remark: what the subscription is for (no line break)

pool.description: the operator's pool: the organizations the root-signed platform log grants the operator's subscriptions; counts only for an owner with the platform role operator

orgs.description: organizations, each at most once (checked by the clients and the runner)

use.description: which sessions besides the owner's own may use the subscription (ADR-090 section 3); absent or empty: measure only
